entries.name: Dobermon X
entries.description: Dobermon X is an enhanced version of Dobermon and retains much of the same shape, with the main difference being the two wickedly-curved blades that now sprout from just after its forelegs. Its fur is now more of a brownish color. The spikes on its collar have grown in length, and the blades at the back of its feet are now curved. It also has got cropped ears.

entries.name: Chief Cabinet Secretary
entries.description: As Mitsuo Yamaki introduced the Hypnos system to the Chief Cabinet Secretary, the Chief reminded Yamaki that his job was not just to prevent new Digimon from entering the Real World, but to eliminate those that were already there. Following the earthquakes that preceeded the arrival of Vikaralamon, Yamaki contacted the Chief Cabinet Secretary to alert him to the impending Bio-Emergence. The secretary warned him that he would not brook another disappointment—so when Vikaralamon destroyed a large portion of the city, the Juggernaut failed to stop him, and a portion of the Hypnos towers was destroyed in an explosion, Yamaki was fired. However, some time later, the secretary and the Head of National Security clashed over what should be done about Hypnos—the head planned to reactivate the system, while the secretary thought it foolish to do so without Yamaki. entries.name: Cougarmon
entries.description: Cougarmon resembles a large bobcat ( Lynx rufus ). It has a stocky, four-legged body with dense fur that is light brown, a cream colored mane on the neck with a white prominent, spiky tuft on the center of the forehead, red eyes with blue swirling patterns around them with a raindrop in between them, long, pointy tufted ears, a downward braid with two golden bells woven into it with the braid held together by a purple tassel, and a short, stubby tail with brown on the tip. Official romanization given by the Digimon Reference Book and used in the franchise.
